scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --kill-signal SIGTERM --kill-timeout 5000 --teardown "node scripts/stop-dev.mjs" --names API,WEB,ANDROID --prefix-colors cyan,magenta,yellow --prefix "[{name}]" "npm run dev --silent --workspace @linguatube/server" "npm run dev --silent --workspace @linguatube/client" "node scripts/android-dev.mjs"
scripts.android:setup: npm run build --workspace @linguatube/client && npm exec --workspace @linguatube/client -- cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build --workspace @linguatube/client && npm run cap:sync --workspace @linguatube/client
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @linguatube/shared && npm run build --workspace @linguatube/server && npm run build --workspace @linguatube/client
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @linguatube/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @linguatube/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
